headline: Weather Desk Admits Forecast Has Become Mostly Guesswork
dek: Meteorologists remain confident that some form of weather will occur.
excerpt: After several conflicting forecasts, the New Zork Weather Desk has revised its outlook to "probably outside."

body.text: NEW ZORK — The New Zork Times Weather Desk issued a revised forecast Friday after admitting that earlier predictions had become increasingly difficult to defend.
The updated forecast calls for temperatures, clouds in some locations, possible sunlight and a continuing chance that conditions will change without consulting anyone.
We can say with considerable confidence that people should look outside before leaving home.
The Weather Desk emphasized that its models remain sophisticated and that the atmosphere continues to be uncooperative.
